title: Resources: New work of delhi
reviewerComment:
Hi, thank you for your support and contribution! This submission creates a new full Delhi Metro template, with map updates covering the whole network. However, the submitted map has several verifiable station-name and route-section mismatches against the current official DMRC network map. The confirmed issues are concentrated around the upper-left Rithala-Kundli / Line 8 construction section, the upper-central Yellow Line area, the central interchange area, the eastern Red Line, the southeast Pink Line, and the lower-right Noida Aqua Line.

Confirmed issues include: the official map shows the upper-left Rithala-Kundli under-construction extension with Narela, Rohini, Bawana, Kundli and related stations, but the submitted map does not include it; North Pitampura should follow the official map as Uttari Pitampura-Prashant Vihar; Azapur should be Azadpur; Garu Teg Bahadur Nagar should be Guru Teg Bahadur Nagar; Undyog Bhagwan does not match the current official Yuge Yugeen Bharat station name; Shaheed Nager, Major Mohit Sharma Rajendra Nager, Mandawali- West Vinod Nargar, East Vinod Nargar-Mayur Vihar II, Doida Sector -15/-16/-18, and Ginda Office all differ from the official spelling.

You may fix these errors, then open a new issue and include this issue number. Please do not try to update this issue again :)
